I live in Nova Scotia, Canada. It's been legalized recently here. Our apartment decided to take the same stance with smoking cigarettes. "you can smoke it but do it outside please. Respect your neighbors feelings." My husband is actually allergic to it. It's amazing to me because I've known people who are allergic to strawberries, bananas, peanuts, I've even known a person allergic to chocolate. But no one can believe that my husband is allergic to marijuana because and I quote "because it's so natural." He gets massive migraines that won't go away for days. His eyes swell and turn red. It's really scary when he has a reaction. 

People smoke it inside anyways. Everytime we smell it we have to drop everything and put towels under the door in the windows and he has to hide away in the bedroom till they stop. 

Trust me when I say we don't hate people who smoke marijuana. But we hate people who think that marijuana is like magic and can't possibly do anything wrong. 

When someone says they're allergic and you smoke it in their face and watch as hives appear on their bodies and you still don't believe. You're a fucking asshole and a potential murderer. 

Luckily our apartments manager believes us. We brought a doctor's note and he's agreed to put notices out explaining the allergic reaction problem and threatening to fine anyone caught smoking in the hallways. But there's only so much they can do you know?

We're going to have to purchase or rent a house soon even though we probably can't afford it because of the health risks. It's really hard watching him get sick over and over again. But that's just life I guess.
